set_value.name: $psB.$fleets.{$psF}
set_value.exact: table[$state = 'idle', $target = null, $since = player.age, $assigned = null, $assignedAt = null, $power = 0.0, $powerAt = null, $share = true]

set_value.name: $psB.$targets.{$psT}
set_value.exact: table[$engaged = [], $pledged = [], $assigned = [], $declined = table[], $busy = false, $group = 0.0, $foes = 0, $fast = null, $groupAt = null, $ratio = null, $help = null, $holdNotified = null, $respAt = null, $via = @$psVia, $seen = player.age]

do_if.value: not @$psPk.exists or $psPk.iswreck or ($psPe.$engaged.count == 0 and $psPe.$pledged.count == 0 and $psPe.$assigned.count == 0 and $psPe.$help == null and player.age - $psPe.$seen gt $boardKeep)
@$psPwE.$powerAt == null or @$psPwE.$armed == null or player.age - $psPwE.$powerAt gt $powerCache

set_value.name: $psPwR
set_value.exact: if $psPwS.isclass.ship_xl then 4 else (if $psPwS.isclass.ship_l then 3 else (if $psPwS.isclass.ship_m then 2 else (if $psPwS.isclass.ship_s then 1 else 0)))

do_if.value: @$psTE.$groupAt == null or @$psTE.$rankN == null or player.age - $psTE.$groupAt gt $groupCache

set_value.name: $psGeRank
set_value.exact: if @$psT.isclass.ship_xl then 4 else (if @$psT.isclass.ship_l then 3 else (if @$psT.isclass.ship_m then 2 else (if @$psT.isclass.ship_s then 1 else 0)))

set_value.name: $psGeR
set_value.exact: if $psGeF.isclass.ship_xl then 4 else (if $psGeF.isclass.ship_l then 3 else (if $psGeF.isclass.ship_m then 2 else (if $psGeF.isclass.ship_s then 1 else 0)))

set_value.name: $psTE.$rankN
set_value.exact: if $psGeRank gt 0 and $psGeRankN lt 1 then 1 else $psGeRankN

set_value.name: $psSgD
set_value.exact: (if $psSgF.isclass.ship_xl then 4 else (if $psSgF.isclass.ship_l then 3 else (if $psSgF.isclass.ship_m then 2 else 1))) - $psSgG

set_value.name: $psSgFit
set_value.exact: (if $psSgG le 2 then $psSgA.{1} else 0) + (if $psSgG le 3 then $psSgA.{2} else 0) + (if $psSgG ge 2 then $psSgA.{3} else 0) + (if $psSgG ge 3 then $psSgA.{4} else 0)

set_value.name: $psSgTier
set_value.exact: if $psSgCount ge (if $psSgG == 3 then $swarmSperL else $swarmMperXL) * @$psTE.$rankN then 2 else 3

do_elseif.value: $psHD gt $radius and @$psTS != null and @$psHS != null and $psHS lt $psTS * $speedFactor

do_if.value: $psHoOk and $psHTierV le 2 and $psHTierV le $psHoTierV and ($psNearestIdle == null or $psHD lt $psNearestIdleDist)

do_elseif.value: $psPolicy and $psOthers gt 0 and $psDist gt $radius and @$psVdTS != null and @$psVdFS != null and $psVdFS lt $psVdTS * $speedFactor
$psOthers gt 0 and ($psExcl or not $psFE.$share) and $psVdTier == 0 and $psDist lt $psSameNear - $handoffMargin

set_value.name: $psWhy
set_value.exact: if $psNearestIdle != null and $psNearestIdleDist lt $psDist - $handoffMargin then 'handoff' else 'solo'

set_value.name: $psWhy
set_value.exact: if $psRatioAll ge $kmin or $psHelpers.count gt 0 then 'help' else 'hold'

set_value.name: $psRebreak
set_value.exact: (@$psP.$state == 'engaged' or $psOp == 'hb') and @$psT.exists and @$psFE.$brokeOff == $psT and player.age - @$psFE.$brokeOffAt le $resendTtl and $psB.$targets.{$psT}? and ($psB.$targets.{$psT}.$engaged.count gt 0 or $psB.$targets.{$psT}.$assigned.count gt 0)

set_value.name: $psVia
set_value.exact: if @$psP.$why == 'resp' then 'attack' else (if @$psP.$why == null or @$psP.$why == 'load' then null else 'scan')

do_if.value: not $psOffered and $psTE.$help != null and @$psOk2.exists and not $psOk2.iswreck and $psOk2.sector == $psF.sector

set_value.name: $psMkWhy
set_value.exact: if $psFE.$refusalWhy == 'skip' then {1972092401, 1404} else if $psFE.$refusalWhy == 'fog' then {1972092401, 1405} else {1972092401, 1459}

do_if.value: @$psFE.$assigned.exists and player.age - @$psFE.$assignedAt le $assignTtl and not @$psFE.$resent and @$psFE.$answer != null

set_value.name: $psCandList
set_value.exact: if $psResend != null then [] else (if @$psP.$cands != null then $psP.$cands else [])

check_value.value: @event.param.exists and event.param.isclass.ship and not @event.param.isplayerowned and not event.param.iswreck

@player.entity.$ProtectSectorBoard.$targets.{event.param}.$respAt == null or player.age - player.entity.$ProtectSectorBoard.$targets.{event.param}.$respAt gt (if (typeof @player.entity.$ProtectSectorConfig.$coordRespCooldown).isnumeric then player.entity.$ProtectSectorConfig.$coordRespCooldown else 30) * 1s

do_if.value: $psF.exists and $psF.isoperational and not $psF.iswreck and not $psF.dps.all and (not $psB.$marked.{$psF}? or $noDpsWhys.indexof.{@$psB.$marked.{$psF}.$why})
